asr.full_text: Hi, this is Normal Yarte, and I want to welcome everyone to this short presentation. Today we will go over the compensation plan for Bitclub Network. What is Bitclub Network? It is a cutting-edge, passive income referral-based company that will teach you how to cash in on Bitcoin and other digital currencies. Who are we? We are a team of experts, investors, professionals, coders, and programming geeks who understand this market. How do you get started with the BitClub network? You pay a one-time membership fee of $99.00. Once your membership is created, you will have 3 mining pools you can engage in. In the first mining pool, you pay $500 per share that pays you for 1,000 days of mining. You receive 50% of the profits and the other 50% will be used to acquire new hardware and repurchase shares into Biclub. In the second mining pool, you pay $1,000 per share that pays you for 1000 days of mining. You receive 60% of the profits and the other 40% will be used to acquire new hardware and repurchase shares into Biclub. In the third mining pool, you paid $2,000 per share that pays you for 1,000 days of mining. You receive 70% of the profits, and the other 30% will be used to acquire new hardware and repurchase shares into Bitclub. Bitclub pays referral commissions. You get paid for referring new Bitclub members. You get paid when someone you refer buys a share of the mining pools. You also get paid on all coins they have earned and are re-invested into the pool. You earn commissions on the Binary Tree when you have 1 person on your left and 1 person on your right. For every 20 shares on your left and right side you earn $400. You can earn 1 cycle per day, and it pays through infinite levels. You receive $50 from 1 of your staff employees who completes a cycle on the Binary. You also receive an additional $50 each from one of your personal enrollees completes a cycle on the binary. You also receive an additional $ 50 each time one of your second generation members completes a cycle Each cycle pays $ 100 in matching bonuses to the Upline. Your first two enrollees will be placed on Team 1, you earn 15% on whatever pool they purchase. This is paid on full and partial shares from the mining pools. On your next third, fourth and fifth person you personally enroll will be placed on Team Number Two. You will earn 20% on whatever pool they purchase. This is paid of full and partial shares from the mining pools. You also earn an additional 5% bonus in their first two personally enrolled people. This is through Infinity. On your next six, seven and eight person you personally enroll, they will be placed on team 3. You will earn 25% on whatever pool they purchase. This is paid on full and partial shares from the mining pool. You will also earn an additional 10% on the first two personally enrolled people. This is paid through infinity. You also receive 5% on all the 3rd, 4th, and 5th people they personally enroll. This is Paid through Infinity. On your 9th person that you enroll, they will be placed on Team number 4. You will earn 27.5% on whatever pull they purchase. This is Paid on full and partial shares from the mining poll. You will also earn an additional 12.5% on the first two personally enrolled people. This is paid through Infinity. You also receive 5% on the third, fourth, and fifth persons they personally enrolled. This is pay through Infinity. He also get 2.5% on all six, seventh, and eight persons they personally enrolled through Infinity. When anyone you personally enroll reaches the level of Team 4. You will receive 2.5% on all the personnel enrolled people that are in team 4. You will also receive an additional 2.5% bonus on all of those first 8 personnel enrolled persons through Infinity. How do you get started with Bitclip Network? You pay a one time membership at the end of the fee of $99. Once your membership is created, we have three mining pool operations you can engage in. Get started now. Don't Wait! Thank you for taking the time to watch this short video. If you need more information, or are ready to join Big Club Network please contact me , or the person who referred you to this video. Thank you, and have a fantastic day!

textual.context: The records present the call to join and register as part of a promotional presentation. The transcription contains apparent name variations, and the supplied records do not establish whether the destination or organization identity is accurate.
textual.potential_relevance: The source combines a registration or contact request and urgency language with the promised ability to engage in paid mining pools and receive stated compensation, making the action-and-benefit relationship relevant for later contextual assessment.
textual.limitations: No external destination was accessed or verified, and the records do not establish whether the urgency was limited by a real deadline or whether registration produced the described benefits.

visual.observation: Slides describe purchasing BitClub mining-pool shares for $500 or $2,000 and receiving daily payments from stated mining profits, with 50% or 70% of profits allocated to share holders.
visual.context: Presented as promotional BitClub Mining Pools material.
visual.potential_relevance: A monetary purchase is directly linked to recurring profit-payment claims and stated profit percentages, which conditionally merits review of the offer and its payment structure.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether mining occurred, whether payments were made, or whether the stated returns were achieved.

visual.observation: The presentation instructs viewers to introduce people into left and right teams and states that reaching specified team-share or cycle conditions can produce a one-time $400 bonus and matching bonuses.
visual.context: Presented as an explanation of a BitClub binary-tree and matching-bonus structure.
visual.potential_relevance: Recruiting or supporting enrolled team members is connected to stated monetary bonuses and cycle conditions, which conditionally merits review of the recruitment-linked compensation structure.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the actual operation of the structure, payment history, or whether participants experienced gains or losses.

visual.observation: The slides state that newly enrolled people are placed into numbered teams and that the presenter can earn percentages on what those team members purchase, including full or partial mining-pool shares and purchases by personally sponsored people.
visual.context: Presented as a level-up team bonus schedule with percentages for successive enrolled positions and sponsored members.
visual.potential_relevance: Enrollment and continued recruitment are linked to percentage commissions based on other members' purchases, which conditionally merits review of the multi-level compensation arrangement.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether commissions were paid, how purchases were funded, or whether the displayed percentages were subject to additional conditions.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a compensation plan that asks viewers to pay a $99 membership fee and buy mining-pool shares while describing daily profit participation. It also ties recruiting members and their purchases or cycle activity to referral commissions, team bonuses, and matching payments, and urges viewers to join through provided contact and registration directions. the available video evidence does not establish whether the mining or payments occurred or verify the linked destination.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation centers on a compensation plan in which recruited members are placed in teams and commissions extend to people those members recruit. It also offers paid mining-pool shares linked to mining profits, supporting S04 separately.
